changelog:
Notification rules: choose when each camera notifies you, about which detections, and where (anywhere, in a zone, or crossing a line).
Muting a detection type now also mutes its line crossings. To keep them, add a rule for that line.
Notification settings no longer dim while a change saves.
Two or more blank drives can be combined into a RAID recording array at install, and more drives can be added later from Settings > Recording.
Settings > Recording shows the RAID array's health, and a failed drive sends an alert.
The devices table shows what each camera detects and whether it records audio.
Alert snapshots now count toward the storage limit. After this update, the oldest footage may be deleted to make them fit.
A full disk no longer leaves recording paused until the hourly cleanup.
H.265 cameras write about half as much to disk.
Unplugging the recording drive can no longer wipe the list of recordings.
An update that hangs now fails instead of showing "Updating…" forever.
The Site Manager live wall shows DVR channels.
Retention fields can be cleared while you type a new value.
A camera can leave Scheduled after its schedule is deleted.
The playback calendar marks the right days across daylight saving changes.
